name: Ayzeo GEO + SEO
author: ayzeo

sections.description:
Ayzeo tracks how AI search engines — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini — mention, cite, and recommend your brand. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Ayzeo platform, giving you visibility into how your content performs in the age of AI-powered search.

AI Visibility Score Tracking

Monitor your brand’s visibility across the four major AI engines. Ayzeo queries each engine, analyzes the responses, and calculates a visibility score so you can see where you stand — and how that changes over time.

Brand Mention & Citation Monitoring

See exactly when and how AI engines mention your brand, link to your content, or recommend your products and services. Know which pages get cited and which ones don’t.

Sentiment Analysis

Understand the tone of AI-generated mentions. Ayzeo classifies each mention as positive, neutral, or negative, helping you spot reputation issues before they spread.

Competitor Share-of-Voice Benchmarking

Compare your AI visibility against competitors. See who dominates the conversation in your niche and identify opportunities to close the gap.

Content Optimization Recommendations

Get actionable suggestions to improve how AI engines understand and reference your content. Recommendations are based on analysis of your site structure, content quality, and technical SEO factors.

LLMs.txt & JSON-LD Schema Generation

Generate and manage an llms.txt file that helps AI crawlers understand your site. The built-in editor lets you customize content or auto-generate it from your latest analysis. JSON-LD structured data support helps search engines and AI models parse your content accurately.

White-Label Reports

Agency accounts can generate white-label reports for client presentations, with your own branding and customized insights.

Simple Setup

Connect your WordPress site in minutes. Install the plugin, enter your Ayzeo API key, and start tracking. No complex configuration required.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Ayzeo platform API to provide its functionality. All analysis, AI visibility queries, and content generation are processed through the Ayzeo servers.

Service: Ayzeo API
API Base URL: https://ayzeo.com/api
Website: https://ayzeo.com
Terms of Service: https://ayzeo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://ayzeo.com/privacy

Data sent to the Ayzeo API includes your site URL (for analysis), search queries (for AI visibility checks), and content prompts (for content generation). An API key is required and is transmitted as a Bearer token with each request. No personal user data is collected or shared beyond what is necessary for the plugin’s functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ayzeo-geo-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Ayzeo GEO+SEO → Settings and enter your Ayzeo API key.
  4. Click “Test Connection” to verify your API key works.
  5. Navigate to the Dashboard to run your first analysis.

To get an API key, create an account at ayzeo.com and set up a project for your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Ayzeo account to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin requires an API key from ayzeo.com. Create an account and add your website as a project to get your key.

Which AI engines does Ayzeo track?

Ayzeo tracks visibility across ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Perplexity, and Gemini (Google).

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. All analysis runs in the WordPress admin area and communicates with the Ayzeo API on demand. Nothing is added to your site’s front-end that would affect page load times. The only front-end addition is the optional llms.txt endpoint.

What is LLMs.txt?

LLMs.txt is a proposed standard (similar to robots.txt) that helps AI models understand your website’s content and structure. The plugin lets you generate, edit, and serve this file automatically at yoursite.com/llms.txt.

Can I use this plugin on multiple sites?

Yes, but each site needs its own project and API key in Ayzeo. Install the plugin on each site and configure it with the corresponding key.
